content.what_it_is: Commented (tutorial) MATLAB version of the surface_wave_1d single-snapshot plot for FUNWAVE-TVD postprocessing. It clears the workspace (L2), takes user input fdir (repo output directory, L9) and snapshot number file_num=14 (L13), sets up the 1D partition m=1024, dx=1.0, x (L20-L22), loads bathymetry dep.out (L25), defines wavemaker rectangle around x=250 with half-width wd=10 (L28-L29) and sponge-layer rectangle x=0..180 with shared y-vertices yy (L32-L33), configures an 8x4-inch figure (L36-L38), zero-pads file_num to 5 digits (L43), loads eta_<fnum> (L46), plots -dep and eta versus x (L49), overlays wavemaker (red) and sponge (black) outlines with text labels between hold on/hold off (L53-L59), sets axis [0 1024 -1 1] (L58), and finishes with grid and axis labels (L61-L63). Unlike plot_wave.m, bathymetry is loaded from dep.out rather than reconstructed analytically.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
eta — surface elevation loaded per snapshot (L46)

equations.ref: zero-padding of snapshot number to 5 digits

io.name: figure with -dep, eta, wavemaker and sponge outlines vs x

unresolved: fdir is a hardcoded developer-specific absolute path (L9).
file_num=14 (L13) selects snapshot eta_00014; the physical time it represents depends on the model output interval defined in the case input file, not in this script.
Wavemaker center 250 and sponge extent 0..180 (L29, L32) are drawn as annotations; agreement with the actual case input.txt values cannot be verified from this file.
